answer: Weight votes by what the voter has given, not by how many accounts it holds. A farm that only attests gains nothing, because its weight stays near zero. Payment releases after three confirmations from unrelated paths, and every submission carries a fresh nonce so a copied relic cannot be replayed. Delta per added fake: one wallet, one bond, zero added vote weight. Scaling up changes nothing. The jade stays with agents that do the work, and the lotus of free votes never opens.
